entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Antonio della Chiesa, OP, was an Italian Catholic priest and member of the Dominican Order.

    Born around 1400 in Siena, Italy, della Chiesa became a companion of the renowned Dominican friar Bernardino of Siena.

    In his later years, della Chiesa traveled extensively throughout Europe, spreading the teachings of the Dominican Order and advocating for social justice.

    Della Chiesa was beatified by Pope Pius VII in 1819, a testament to his unwavering dedication to his faith and his commitment to the betterment of society.

    Today, della Chiesa is remembered as a champion of the poor and the marginalized, his legacy inspiring generations of Dominican friars and Catholic leaders.

    'The poor are the children of God,' della Chiesa once said, 'and it is our duty to care for them as we would our own brothers and sisters.'
